verdict.rationale: Svelte's own docs say its compiler turns components into lean, tightly optimized JavaScript that does minimal work in the browser. One community team independently reported a night-and-day bundle-size improvement after migrating from React, which supports the small-runtime-footprint part of the story. However, nothing in the pack covers dependency count or supply-chain risk, and there are no measured bundle sizes. Missing for 10: documented runtime/bundle size figures, evidence of minimal or zero runtime dependencies, any supply-chain risk claims or corroboration.
